gloss: to pile up (snow, ash); to accumulate

definitions.gloss: to pile up; to lie deep (snow, ash, leaves)
definitions.explanation: Of snow, volcanic ash, or fallen leaves: to fall and build up in a layer on the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧{降|ふ}り{積|つ}もった。
examples.english: Thirty centimetres of snow piled up overnight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火山灰|かざんばい}→火山灰：19412_kazanbai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧{降|ふ}り{積|つ}もって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: After the eruption, volcanic ash lay thick over the town.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (to fall) and ⟦{積|つ}もる→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧ (to pile up). It stresses both the falling and the build-up, so it is common in descriptions and weather reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{積|つ}もる: snow piles up
- {降|ふ}り{積|つ}もった⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧: fallen snow, the snow on the ground
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{降|ふ}り{積|つ}もる: fallen leaves pile up

ASPECT (ている):
- {降|ふ}り{積|つ}もって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the resulting state: snow lies on the ground.
